Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is all we have from this thrilling encounter! The series is levelled at 1-1 and in a quick turnaround, the third T20I will be played on the same ground on Tuesday, 2nd of August. It will start at 8 pm IST (2.30 pm GMT). Our build-up though begins a lot earlier. So do join us for the same. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Nicholas Pooran, the skipper of West Indies says that it was very pleasing win and he can finally breathe now. He says there have been a couple of close games which they lost but it feels good to be on the winning side this time. He praises Obed McCoy along with other bowlers and says that they did a wonderful job restricting India to a below par score. He says the batters gave a really good start but in the middle they lost their way a bit, nevertheless a win is a win. He tells that it did not work for him and Hetmyer today but they want to continue taking the responsibility. He also praised King for the way he batted and says that he should learn from this game and finish games off in the future. He tells Thomas returned from an injury and managed to put up a nice performance on his home ground. He ends by saying that Obed McCoy is a bit of a freak and they need to deal with it but it is lovely to have him in the team as he gives them a left-arm option as well.

Rohit Sharma, the skipper of India is in for a chat. He starts by saying they did not get enough runs on the board. He says they will try to learn from the mistakes they made in this game and hopefully they will come back stronger. On giving the final over to Avesh Khan, he says that it is important to put them into tough situations and give them a feel of how it is to bowl under pressure for India. These young bowlers have done it in the Indian T20 League but this is a different ball game. Also adds that with these performances, they shouldn't let themselves down. Mentions they shouldn't panic after losing a game.

Obed McCoy is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his incredible bowling performance. He starts by thanking God and says that he has been doing this for his mom who is sick and that keeps him motivated. He says that getting wickets in the powerplay was key. He adds that in the previous match he was overthinking and he improved that in this game which helped him to execute his plans. He ends by saying he is thankful for all the experiences and challenges.
Presentation time.

Earlier in the game, India struggled with the bat after Pooran decided to bowl first on a tricky pitch. Obed McCoy was the star for the Windies as he took a six-fer and that gave Windies a great chance coming into the second half. It turned out to a quite a thrilling chase in the end and it was West Indies who managed to get the better of India on the day.

Indian bowlers should be credited for taking the game to the final over. They were defending a very modest total and needed early wickets but sadly it was not the case in this game. However, Pandya bowled brilliantly in the middle overs along with the spinners and that kept India in the game. Avesh Khan got an important wicket of King in the 16th over and Arshdeep Singh once again showed why he is rated so highly as he gave away just 6 runs in the 19th over and got a big wicket of Powell. Avesh Khan was trusted in the final over by the skipper over Bhuvneshwar Kumar but unfortunately for him, things did not go according to the plan for the youngster.

West Indies were chasing a below-par total and they got off to a perfect start with the bat as well as the Windies openers went onto score 46 runs in the Powerplay. Mayers departed just after the Powerplay but Pooran and King steadied the ship and West Indies were at one stage motoring along nicely towards a comfortable victory. However, Pooran departed in the 10th over and Hetmyer too could not last long. West Indies still were in a comfortable position with just 38 needed off 30 balls and seven wickets in hand. The wicket of King brought some panic in the Windies dressing room and it came to the situation where the Windies needed 10 off the last over and Thomas came to the rescue and finished the game for the Windies after some nervy moments in the final few overs.

WEST INDIES PULL OFF A LAST-OVER THRILLER! Spare a thought for Avesh Khan. He started the over defending 9 but perhaps on the very first ball itself, sealed the fate. Yes, Thomas did hit a six and a four but had that first ball not been a no ball, maybe, this game could have had a different or a longer finish. Anyways, West Indies have levelled the series but they nearly made a mess of it in the death overs. However, they have managed to cross the line in the end and this sets us up nicely for the remaining three games of this series.
FOUR! Devon Thomas gets the winning runs with a fine boundary. It is a length ball, outside off. Devon Thomas cuts it through point for four. WEST INDIES WIN THE GAME BY 5 WICKETS.

SIX! BOOM! Devon Thomas is making a solid statement with the blade here! It is a short ball, outside off. Devon Thomas stands tall and smokes it over the wide long off fence for a maximum. Devon Thomas makes the most of the Free Hit here.
A low full toss, on off. Smith hits it hard to long off. The batters take one. Oh, no! The umpire signals a no ball as the bowler oversteps. Free Hit to follow.

Avesh Khan will bowl the final over! This is quite surprising, Rohit Sharma has opted for Avesh Khan over Bhuvneshwar Kumar! Maybe, he wants to put the youngster in the tough situation ahead of the World Cup and want to see how he responds.
A full-length ball, on off. Devon Thomas comes down the track and drives it towards sweeper cover. Dinesh Karthik sprints to his right and keeps it down to two runs. 10 needed in the final over now!
Two is the call but they only get one! It is a low full toss, on off. Smith slaps it down to long off. Hardik Pandya is quick to get to the ball. They take one. 12 needed in 7 balls.
Swing and a miss! Full length, wide outside off. Smith tries to go downtown but only connects with thin air.

Overthrows this time! It is full, on off. Smith pushes it to extra cover and scampers across for a quick single. Avesh Khan collects the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. There is no one backing up and the batters take one more.
Odean Smith walks out to the middle. Can he do the job for the Windies?

OUT! TIMBER! Arshdeep Singh just keeps on delivering under pressure. Is there a twist left in the tale? West Indies lose their fifth wicket. Arshdeep Singh fires in a yorker, in the blockhole. Rovman Powell tries to dig it away but plays the wrong line. The ball sneaks past his blade to rattle the stumps. West Indies need 15 more now off 10 balls.
Arshdeep Singh comes 'round the wicket and angles it in full and on middle. Devon Thomas pushes it to long off for an easy single. Arshdeep Singh has been on the money in the death overs so far.
Length ball, on off. Thomas mistimes his pull to deep square leg for a single.
SIX! BANG! This should ease some pressure. It is short, on off. Thomas sends it sailing over the mid-wicket fence with a pull shot.
Short ball, on off. Powell pulls it to wide of long on for a single.
Goes full and on leg, Devon Thomas drills it towards long on for a single.

In the air but once again the ball falls in no man's land. He bowls it short again and on middle, Rovman Powell goes for the pull but miscues it and the ball goes up in the air. Luckily for Powell it falls in the vacant short mid off area. They get a single again.

Cries of 'catch it' but the ball falls well short of the fielder. This is short and on middle and leg, Devon Thomas pulls it high in the air but it falls way before the deep square leg fielder. They cross.
Hardik Pandya comes back to bowl his last over!
Fuller, on middle and leg. Thomas drills it to long off for a single. Just 4 runs off the over.
Back of a length, on the bodyline. Rovman Powell looks to hook it away. It hits him on the body off the gloves. The batters sneak a quick single.
Fuller, on off. Thomas drives it through cover-point for a single.
Two dots on the trot! A slower one now, on a length, on top of leg. Devon Thomas gets inside the line and tries to flick it away but misses.
Swing and a miss! Arshdeep Singh comes from 'round the wicket and serves it on a length, wide outside off. Devon Thomas tries to punch it away but misses.
Singh fires in a yorker, on off. Powell gets his blade down in time and works it to long off for a single.
Arshdeep Singh is back into the attack. Two overs for 16 runs so far.
Short ball, on the body. Powell pulls it to deep square leg for a single. 7 runs and a wicket off it.
Length, on off, blocked to point.
Nicely bowled! Full length, outside off, this one nips in off the deck. Rovman Powell looks to defend it on the front foot. He gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Rovman Powell is the next batter in.

OUT! KNOCKED HIM OVER! Avesh Khan  with a great comeback after being hit for a six. He nails the yorker this time. Brandon King once again tries to make room by going to the leg side but he cannot put his bat down in time to dig this one out. The ball goes through and crashes into the stumps. Brandon King has to go back but he has done his job. India still in the game, can they get couple of wickets quickly to put more pressure on the Windies?
SIX! What a shot! This is on a length and on middle and leg, Brandon King stands tall and smokes it over the long on fence for a biggie.
Great bowling by Avesh. This is full and way outside off, Brandon King moves to his left way before the ball has been bowled which gives Avesh the chance to change his line.
Avesh Khan is back on. He went for 12 runs in his first over!
Tad shorter in length again, on off. King pushes it to long off for a single.
On the shorter side, on off. Thomas punches it to covers for a single.

Misfield by Ashwin! Not ideal when you have to defend a low total. This is fuller and around off. Thomas drives it off the outside half of his blade towards right of backward point. Ashwin there misfields and it allows the batters to take two.
Angling into leg. Thomas paddles it to fine leg for a couple.
Beaten! This is fuller and outside off. Thomas looks to drive it away but misses.
A flatter one, around off. Tad shorter as well and King cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Slightly short, outside off. King punches it through covers for a quick single.
Fuller, on middle and leg, King eases it back to the bowler.
Excellent fielding! It is full, outside off. King slashes it hard toward wide long off. Suryakumar Yadav does well in the deep to save a boundary. They take two.
FOUR! Powerful hit! This is floated full and on off, Brandon King goes down and smashes it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed up full and on off, Devon Thomas taps it to point for a single.
Darts this one on leg, skids through of the deck, Devon Thomas looks to flick it but gets hit on his thigh pads.

A huge appeal for lbw! The umpire shows no interest. Rohit Sharma though decides to take the review. It is tossed up, around off, turning in a touch. Brandon King gets down on one knee and tries to sweep it away but misses. He gets rapped on the pads. The umpire shows no interest but Sharma thinks otherwise. The UltraEdge show no bat is involved. The Ball Tracking shows that the impact is outside the line. The original decision stands. Rohit Sharma's ploy of taking the review does not benefit his side.
This is full and on the stumps. King stays back and dabs it down past backward point. Two runs taken.
Darts this one on leg, Devon Thomas looks to flick it but misses and gets hit on his thigh pads.
Devon Thomas is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Ravindra Jadeja takes a blinder to send Hetmyer back in the hut. This is short and on middle and leg, it is there to be hit. Shimron Hetmyer makes room but gets cramped a bit due to the pace and hits uppishly but firmly towards the bowler. Ravindra Jadeja shows quick reflexes and takes a sharp low catch moving to his left. However, the umpires wants to check if the catch is clean or not as Jadeja takes it quite low. The replays shows that there is no need to change the decision and Hetmyer has to go. A much needed wicket for India and Windies are three down now.
Short and on middle and leg, Brandon King pulls it awkwardly to square leg and scampers across for a quick single.
Flatter and quicker on middle, Brandon King knocks it back to the bowler.
FIFTY FOR KING! A very composed knock from the opener. It is full and on off. King eases it to mid on and crosses for one. He soaks himself in the applause.
Full and on off. Shimron Hetmyer tries to push it through covers. It goes towards mid on off the inner half. They cross for one.
BEATEN! It is tossed up, outside off. It grips and turns in with some extra bounce. Shimron Hetmyer tries to block it on the front foot but gets beaten.
FOUR! Slapped! It is a short ball, on off. Shimron Hetmyer pulls it powerfully towards long on and gets a boundary.
Flatter one, outside off. King cuts it through point for one.
Touch short, on middle and leg. King blocks it back the bowler.

NOT OUT! Shimron Hetmyer survives. Hardik Pandya bowls this on a length again and on off, nips away, Shimron Hetmyer tries to guide it to the off side but gets a thin outside edge towards the keeper. Rishabh Pant takes the catch and appeals for it but the umpires are not sure about it. They take it upstairs to see if the catch is clean or not. The soft signal is not out. The UltraEdge shows that there is clear bat involved but the replay shows the ball bouncing in front of Pant before he pouches it. So, the on field decision remains.

Is that out? India have appealed for a caught behind. The umpire though wants to check whether the catch is taken cleanly or not? The soft signal is NOT OUT! The replays roll in and first they check for the UltraEdge and there is a clear spike, he has nicked this. So the question now is whether Pant took that cleanly? The answer is NO! The replays show that the ball goes off the bounce into the gloves. Shimron Hetmyer will continue.
Nice slower bouncer from Pandya. This is on off, shaping away a bit, Shimron Hetmyer thinks about playing it but decides to leave it alone at the end.
Full and on off, Shimron Hetmyer miscues his drive to point.
Pulls his length back a bit and on off, Brandon King watches it through and guides it towards third man for a single.

This is full again and on middle and leg, Shimron Hetmyer tries to work it on the leg side but gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but the finger stays down. The ball looped up of his pads towards the short third man region. There is an overthrow and the batters get one leg bye.
Serves this full and on middle from 'round the wicket, Shimron Hetmyer blocks it to covers.
Shimron Hetmyer wastes no time in getting off the mark. It is darted on the pads, Shimron Hetmyer clips it to short mid-wicket and crosses for one. West Indies need 66 runs off 60 balls.
Looped up, full and on off. King taps it to point and rotates the strike.
Shimron Hetmyer walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! A big wicket for India. Ravichandran Ashwin breaks this stand which was starting to hurt them. It is tossed up, full and on off. Pooran dances down the track and goes for the lofted drive. He does not get the desired distance on it and ends up hitting it high in the air towards long on. Suryakumar Yadav settles under it and takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Suryakumar Yadav b Ravichandran Ashwin

Commentary.Commentary: Short ball, on off. King makes room and cuts it hard to deep point for just a single.
Tossed up, on middle and leg. Pooran tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
Full, on off. King hits it down to long on for a single.
Ravichandran Ashwin is back on. He went for 12 runs in his first over.
Almost a yorker and on off, Brandon King digs it towards mid off for a quick single.

Great fielding there. This is back of a length and on middle, Brandon King goes on his back foot and swats it towards mid-wicket. Dinesh Karthik at short mid-wicket does well diving to his left to stop the single.
Good length delivery again and on middle, Nicholas Pooran gets into position early but miscues his pull to the leg side. They cross.
On a length and on off, Nicholas Pooran dabs it to point.
Bangs another short ball but this time on outside off, Nicholas Pooran tries to slash at it but misses. The Indians appeal for a 'catch' but the umpire is not interested. The umpire calls it a wide.
Short and on middle , Nicholas Pooran pulls it hard but straight to short mid-wicket.
Length delivery on middle, Brandon King tries to play it to the off side but mistimes his shot to long on. They get a single.
Full-length ball, wide outside off, angled across the left-hander. Nicholas Pooran tries to reach out but misses. An expensive start with the ball for Avesh Khan.
Back of a length, outside off. King works it to deep backward point and rotates the strike.
Swing and a miss! A slower bouncer this time, outside off. King stays back and tries to chase it but misses. It meets the keeper on a bounce.
Khan goes full, on off. Pooran drives it to mid off for a quick single.
SIX! High and handsome! It is a short ball, on the body. Nicholas Pooran swivels on the back foot and smokes it over the square leg fence for a maximum. This one goes way back into the crowd.
FOUR! Top shot! It is full, wide outside off. Nicholas Pooran reaches out and crunches it past backward point for a boundary.
Avesh Khan is into the attack now.
Play and miss! He bowls this full and outside off, Brandon King goes for the cover drive but gets beaten.

EDGY BUT FOUR! This is on a good length and outside off, Brandon King tries to cut at it but only manages a thick outside edge past the wicket keeper. The ball races away to the third man fence for a boundary.
Good length and on the leg stump, Nicholas Pooran stays back and tucks it through square leg for one. He gets off the mark with that.
Goes full and wide of off, Nicholas Pooran slashes hard at it but misses it completely.
Length ball, on off. King stays back and dabs it down to third man for an easy single.
Nicholas Pooran walks out at number 3!

OUT! TAKEN! Hardik Pandya comes into the attack and gets the breakthrough straightaway. He bowls this full and on the pads, Kyle Mayers tries to flick it over the fine leg fence but cannot get the right power behind it and hits it high up in the air. Ravichandran Ashwin there did not have to move much as he pouches it safely. Can India capitalise on this breakthrough?
Commentary.Howout: c Ravichandran Ashwin b Hardik Pandya

Commentary.Commentary: Hardik Pandya is into the attack now.
Fuller, on off. Kings blocks it to covers. 12 runs off the over. A great one for West Indies. At the end of Powerplay, West Indies are 46/0.
Flatter and short, outside off. King tries to cut it away but gets beaten.
SIX! All the way! Brandon King is on a roll! It is fuller, on middle and leg. Brandon King comes down the track and tonks it over the bowler's head for a maximum.
FOUR! Nicely played! It is floated and full, on leg. Brandon King comes inside the line of the delivery, gets down on one knee and sweeps it over short fine leg. One bounce into the ropes.
Tossed up, on the stumps. Kyle Mayers goes back and works it to long on for a single.
Fuller, on middle and leg, Brandon King flicks it to wide long on for a single.
Change. So spin from both ends now, as Ravichandran Ashwin is brought into the attack. He replaces Arshdeep Singh.
Single to end the over! This is fuller on middle. King knocks it down to long on for a single.
Jadeja continues to fire his deliveries on the middle stump line. King makes room and drives it to the cover fielder.

FOUR! This time he finds the gap! Jadeja bowls it on the middle stump line again. This time King decides to sweep it. He does that perfectly as the ball races away through the gap towards the square leg fence.
Same result again! This is darted on middle and leg. King makes some room and drills it to the cover fielder again.
Fires it flatter on middle. King skips down the track and hits it straight to the cover fielder.
On the shorter side, on off. King punches it to covers.
Change. Ravindra Jadeja comes into the attack now.
Dot to end the over, so despite a boundary and a no ball, only 6 runs from it. On a length, angling into leg. Mayers looks to clip it but misses. The ball hits his pads and goes towards the leg side.
Pulls his length back, on off. Mayers defends it towards the off side.

FOUR! Mayers slams this down the ground and that boundary might just open the floodgates for Mayers. This is full on middle. Mayers drills it powerfully and the ball races away towards the long fence.
NO BALL! Arshdeep Singh oversteps, this is on the shorter side, on off. Mayers pulls it to mid-wicket. Free Hit coming up.
This is a slower short delivery on off. Mayers pulls it but is early on the shot again and the ball goes off the bottom of his blade onto the turf.

Just short of the mid-wicket fielder! This is full and on the pads. Mayers flicks it bit uppishly but the ball ends up falling a bit short of Bhuvneshwar Kumar at mid-wicket. He stops it quite well in the end.
Tad shorter and around off. King cuts it to deep point for a single.
Single to end the over, 7 from it! Back of a length and around off. King punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
On the shorter side again, on off. King pushes it to covers this time.
Bangs it short on middle. Mayers pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Short and outside off. King cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.

FOUR! Finds the edge but it races away towards the fence. It is a length delivery, around off. King looks to defend but just opens the face of his blade at the last moment and the ball goes away towards the third man fence for a boundary. It looked like an edge initially but it was well played by King.
Back of a length, on off. King blocks it off the back foot back to the bowler. Not much swing for Bhuvneshwar Kumar so far.
Another slower delivery that outfoxes the batter! It is a slower short delivery, outside off. Mayers is early on his pull shot and misses it completely.
Back of a length, outside off. King punches it to deep cover for a single.
Great change of pace! A slower length delivery, that is angled away from the batter. It is around off and King is beaten as he looks to push it towards the off side.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for King! This is on the shorter side and outside off. King cuts it well in front of square this time for a boundary. He is timing it beautifully today.
FOUR! Excellent timing! Back of a length, around off. King just waits for it and steers it through backward point for a boundary.
Up and over, but just a single! This is full, around off. It is swinging away and Mayers lifts it aerially but short of the sweeper cover for a single.
Arshdeep Singh to share the new ball.
Mayers is off the mark as well! This is full and on the pads. Mayers flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Keeps it a tad short, around off. It bounces sharply but Mayers manage to defend it onto the turf nicely in the end.
On the shorter side, on off. Mayers blocks it solidly off the middle of his blade to mid off.
Back of a length and angling into leg. King looks to clip it but misses. The ball brushes his pads and goes behind square on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Kumar goes a tad fuller and closer to off this time. King dabs it towards point.
FOUR! West Indies and Brandon King are underway in style! Bhuvneshwar Kumar bowls it short and outside off. King cuts it firmly past the diving fielder at cover-point for a boundary.
